About the role

As Data Platform Manager you will own Destinus's company data platform. Built on Microsoft Fabric, it brings together data from our different systems, and it serves the reporting and data agents that production, supply chain, program management, and finance work from every week.

You will own its architecture: how OneLake and our lakehouses are structured, how data lands in them from the systems we run, and how it holds up as more of the business comes to depend on it. You will lead a small team of data engineers — setting direction, reviewing their work, growing them — and you will keep building yourself. You are also the person who makes our AI ambitions possible: the foundation behind our data agents and our Company Brain is yours to design and deliver.

At Destinus we are redefining the future of aerospace manufacturing, building advanced Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) across three European plants. The data you will work with is physical — parts, build progress, shortages, non-conformances — and the questions asked of it get harder each year as we grow. If you want a platform you can still shape rather than one already set in concrete, this is a good moment to arrive.

What You'll Do

  • Own the architecture of our Microsoft Fabric estate end to end — OneLake, our lakehouses and their bronze, silver, and gold layers, workspace and domain structure, naming conventions, and the standards that keep it coherent as it grows.
  • Lead, mentor, and grow a small team of data engineers: set priorities, review code, raise the technical bar, and develop the people.
  • Stay hands-on. You will build pipelines, notebooks, and Delta tables yourself, not only direct others who do.
  • Own the integrations that land data in OneLake from our source systems — ERP, HR, shopfloor, quality, and the business applications that come after them — choosing sensibly between Data Factory pipelines, dataflows, shortcuts, and mirroring for each source.
  • Own the gold layer and the semantic models built on it, so that Power BI reads from one governed source rather than from copies scattered around the business.
  • Work closely with our Business Operations & Data Specialists, who represent the business owners of each domain: turn their requirements into the right gold tables, agree definitions with them, and give them a platform they can query, validate, and explain to the business with confidence.
  • Own lineage across the estate: know what feeds what, be able to prove it to an auditor, and make dependencies visible rather than tribal knowledge.
  • Build the data foundation for our AI programme — the lakehouse structures, pipelines, and knowledge graph behind our Fabric data agents and our Company Brain — and deliver it to a standard that can be trusted with a real question.
  • Design and maintain the OneLake security and access model together with your team: workspace roles, access groups, and the controls that decide who sees what in the lake.
  • Keep the platform reliable, observable, and cost-aware: monitoring, alerting, recovery, and disciplined use of our Fabric capacity — including knowing what a runaway notebook costs us.

Requirements

What You’ll Need

Requirements

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5-8 years of data engineering experience, including real ownership of a lakehouse architecture rather than only delivering against someone else's.
  • Hands-on Microsoft Fabric experience is strongly preferred — OneLake, lakehouses, Delta tables, the SQL analytics endpoint, Data Factory pipelines, Spark notebooks, and semantic models in Direct Lake mode. If your depth is in Azure Synapse, Databricks, or Data Lake Storage Gen2 and you have since moved onto Fabric in earnest, we will take that seriously.
  • Strong command of the medallion pattern and of Delta Lake in practice: partitioning, schema evolution, table maintenance, and why a gold table behaves the way it does.
  • Genuinely hands-on. Strong SQL, solid PySpark, and comfort building and orchestrating pipelines yourself. This is not a role that stops at diagrams.
  • Practical understanding of Fabric capacity: how workloads consume it, how to spot what is burning it, and how to keep the platform inside its envelope.
  • Experience leading engineers — formally, or as a technical lead who set direction and mentored others. A first step into people management is welcome if the technical leadership is already there.
  • Proven integration experience with ERP systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365 / MSD, as well as APIs, flat-file landings, and change data capture from operational databases.
  • Solid data modelling skills, including dimensional modelling and an understanding of how a semantic layer serves Power BI.
  • Working knowledge of lineage, data governance, and access control in a cloud platform; exposure to Microsoft Purview is a plus.
  • Interest or experience in the data foundations behind AI assistants — retrieval, knowledge graphs, and preparing data so that an agent can answer with it.
  • Aerospace or another regulated industry is an advantage; so is experience in a start-up or scale-up.
  • Fluent in English; additional European languages are a plus.

Who You Are

You are an architect who never stops building. You have strong opinions about how a platform should be structured, and you earn the right to them by being in the code. You would rather make a design decision explicit and documented than let it live in one person's head.

You care more about reliability than novelty. You know that the measure of a data platform is whether people trust the numbers that come out of it on a Monday morning, not how modern the stack looks on a slide. When something breaks, you want to know why it was possible, not just how to patch it.

You enjoy growing engineers, and you understand that leading a small team means doing the work alongside them. Above all, you want to build something durable — a foundation that holds while the company scales on top of it.

About the role

Behind every well-run plant is a shared understanding of how it is performing — and that understanding has to be built. As a Business Operations & Data Specialist focused on Production & Quality at Destinus, you are the bridge between the people who run our plants and the data that describes them. Plant managers, production leads, and quality engineers own the processes; our lakehouse holds the data those processes create. Your job is to connect the two, so that every production and quality figure, from the shopfloor to the leadership team, is defined by the business, built on the lakehouse, and trusted by both.

This is as much an operations role as a reporting one. You will translate what the business needs to know into what the data platform has to deliver, working with our Data Engineers on the production and quality data in the lakehouse and turning it into the reporting used across three European plants, including our Digital Shopfloor Management Solution, relied on by more than 300 people. You will also go to where the data is created and make it better there — improving how it is captured, automating what is still manual, and helping three plants work to one standard.

At Destinus, we are redefining the future of aerospace manufacturing — bringing speed, precision, and innovation to every process that powers our advanced Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our operations span multiple plants and teams, and your work will directly support the reliability, efficiency, and excellence required for mission-critical production. Join us in shaping the next era of aerospace operations.

What You'll do

  • Be the go-to contact between the business owners of production and quality data — plant managers, production leads, and quality engineers — and our lakehouse: turn their questions into clear data requirements, and the data back into answers they can act on.
  • Own the production and quality portfolio end to end: define the KPI, improve the process behind it, build the dashboard, and stand behind the number.
  • Own the production and quality domain in our lakehouse: know which tables and fields hold what, where each comes from, and who owns it at source — and keep that knowledge documented rather than in your head.
  • Partner with our Data Engineers on the curated (gold) layer for production and quality: specify the tables, fields, and business rules the business needs, and validate the result against what actually happens on the shopfloor before anyone relies on it.
  • Set and monitor data quality checks for your domain, and route each issue to the right owner — the person entering the data, the system configuration, or the pipeline — until it is fixed.
  • Maintain and continuously improve Power BI dashboards tracking production and quality performance across all three plants, built on certified lakehouse data rather than side spreadsheets.
  • Describe production and quality data in plain business language — what each field means, who owns it, and how sensitive it is — for our shared meanings layer, so that colleagues and our AI assistants can use it correctly without having to ask you first.
  • Automate what is manual today: recurring reports, data collection, and the preparation behind daily and weekly performance routines.
  • Support the standardisation of ways of working across the three plants, partnering with our Lean Operations Specialist so that measurement and improvement pull in the same direction.

Requirements

What You’ll Need

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Quality Management, or a related field.
  • Experience in a production or quality environment; aerospace or another regulated industry is highly preferred.
  • Solid understanding of manufacturing and quality metrics — throughput, cycle time, OEE, scrap and rework, first-pass yield — and of quality processes such as non-conformance handling, customer complaints and field returns, root cause analysis, and corrective actions.
  • Strong expertise in Power BI (data modeling, DAX, dashboard design, troubleshooting), complemented by advanced Excel skills.
  • Comfortable querying data with SQL and working in a lakehouse or data warehouse environment; experience with Microsoft Fabric or a medallion (bronze/silver/gold) architecture is a plus. You will not build the pipelines — you need to know what to ask for and how to check what comes back.
  • Able to explain data to non-technical colleagues and business needs to technical ones — and to get both sides to agree on one definition.
  • Knowledge of ERP systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365 / MSD, and familiarity with shopfloor or MES systems.
  • A track record of improving or automating a process, not only reporting on it. Exposure to continuous improvement methods is a plus.
  • Comfortable working across multiple sites and collaborating with production teams, quality engineers, and leadership alike.
  • Fluent in English; Spanish, German or Dutch is a strong plus given our plant locations.
  • Experience in a start-up or scale-up environment is preferred.

Who You Are

You are equally comfortable on a shopfloor and in a data model, and you speak both languages — the plant's and the lakehouse's. You know that the fastest way to fix a reporting problem is often to walk to the place where the data is created and ask how it gets entered — and then change it.

You are structured and persistent, because aligning three plants on one way of working takes more than a good spreadsheet; it takes patience and conversations. You enjoy the detail of a root cause but stay focused on whether performance actually improved, and when something is manual or repetitive you would rather automate it than live with it.

You turn numbers into stories, stories into priorities, and priorities into measurable change. Above all, you take ownership, challenge assumptions, and stay committed to operational excellence.

About the role

Every number that reaches our leadership team, our board, and our auditors has to be right the first time — and that is where you come in. You own how finance data is defined, where it comes from, how it is produced, and how it reaches the people who make decisions with it.

What You’ll Need

We run on D365, and someone who already knows it will be effective months earlier. An interest in improving how the system is configured and used matters as much as knowing where to click.
  • A track record of simplifying or automating a process, not only reporting on it.
  • Experience supporting an external audit, or working in a multi-entity, multi-currency international group, is a strong advantage.
  • Fluent in English; additional European languages are a plus.
  • Experience in a start-up or scale-up environment is preferred.

Who You Are

You are precise, and you are curious about where a number came from before you are comfortable reporting it — whether that means reading the ledger or querying the lakehouse. You know the difference between a figure that looks right and a figure that can be traced back to its source, and you care about the second one.

You are not content to rebuild the same report every month. When something is manual, repetitive, or fragile, your instinct is to go upstream and fix it rather than absorb it. You enjoy working with finance colleagues who ask hard questions, and you would rather be challenged on a detail than have it slip through.

Above all, you want your work to be relied on, by the CFO, by the board, and by anyone who audits it.

Je bent continu, datagedreven op zoek naar verbetering; zodat we het volgende verhaal nóg beter vertellen.

Wat je gaat doen

Onze retentiestrategie wordt steeds geavanceerder. We sturen niet simpelweg 'een korting' naar alle klanten maar werken met gelaagde acties, inspirerende verhalen en gepersonaliseerde extra’s.

Enerzijds ben jij de analytische drijfkracht achter de executie van onze campagnes. Je bouwt, beheert en verbetert de analytische tooling en dashboards zodat we kunnen blijven leren. Daarmee creëer je begrip van - en grip op - de commerciële impact van campagnes, en alle onderliggende onderdelen (zoals kanaalstrategie, product-samenstelling of klantdoelgroep). Vervolgens vertaal je de verworven inzichten effectief naar succesfactoren, verbeteringstrajecten en/of toekomstige experimenten. Anderzijds werk je inhoudelijk mee. Je bepaalt samen met de Campaign Specialist welk aanbod naar welke klanten gaat, via welk kanaal en met welke verwachting en zet je ook (nieuwe) acties zelf op.

Een aantal van jouw verantwoordelijkheden:

At Deeploy, we help organisations roll out AI they can trust. Banks, insurers and pharma companies have to show they control their AI use, and most don’t yet have the tooling to do so. Deeploy gives them that control. We work with dozens of enterprise customers in finance, insurance and healthcare.

You’ll own deals from first outreach to signed contract, with a focus on the Netherlands and Northwest Europe. Most of our buyers have never bought AI governance before, so much of the work is helping them define the problem and build the internal case. You report to the COO, and the founders stay involved in deals.

What you’ll do

  • Deals: run enterprise deals from qualification to close. Deals typically take 6 to 12 months and involve risk, compliance, legal, IT and a business sponsor. The GRC (governance, risk and compliance) function is often the way in.

  • Pipeline: build a large part of your own pipeline through outbound, your network, our partners and events. Marketing runs campaigns with you.

  • Visibility: speak at events and roundtables for risk, compliance and AI governance audiences.

  • Feedback: bring back what buyers respond to, how they compare us with alternatives, and what they miss in the product.

  • Process: help set up how we qualify, forecast and run deals, and later how we onboard new sellers. We’re a small team that works with AI daily, so you’ll also build some of your own tools and agents.

After 12 months

  • You’ve closed at least 4 new enterprise accounts and built €1m+ of qualified pipeline.

  • AI Governance officers know Deeploy, and know you.

  • You have proven to yourself as part of our team, culture and processes.

Who we’re looking for

  • You’ve closed complex enterprise deals with long cycles and several stakeholders, ideally in financial services, insurance, pharma or life sciences.

  • You know how risk, compliance or IT buyers think, from selling GRC, security, data or AI software, or from working on the buyer side.

  • You have a network among these buyers in the Netherlands or elsewhere in Northwest Europe.

  • You can discuss the EU AI Act and how AI systems are built and monitored with some confidence. You don’t need to be an engineer.

  • You’ve worked at an early-stage company or founded one, and you’re comfortable building pipeline from scratch.

  • Fluent English. Dutch or German is a strong plus.

What the role is, and what it is not

It is a builder role. Deal ownership comes first, commercial process a close second.

It is not a lead-execution seat, and you don’t carry the number alone. The founders stay close to deals and are responsible for the commercial function.

What we offer

  • Competitive base and bonus

  • Share plan from day 1

  • Pension plan and other benefits

  • Hybrid working from The Stack in Amsterdam, home to around 40 AI startups

  • The chance to be part of an early stage startup, building the sales function and grow with it

Hiring process

  1. Application: your CV or LinkedIn, and something you’ve worked on that you’re proud of

  2. Introductory call (30 minutes)

  3. Conversation with two people you’d work with closely (60 minutes)

  4. Case study (3 hours, timeboxed), presented to two team members

  5. Offer

About the Role 🎯

As a Senior Customer Success Manager at DataSnipper, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring our customers achieve their goals using our innovative, AI-powered solutions. You will own the customer journey, from onboarding to driving long-term value and retention, fostering strong relationships built on trust and collaboration. You’ll help customers unlock their potential value while contributing to the growth and success of our business.

This role offers a unique opportunity to work closely with professionals who are the backbone of global capital markets, deliver exceptional service, and build a thriving community for our customers. If you’re passionate about customer success and ready to own the moment, we’d love to hear from you!

 
 

About DataSnipper

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals to make those judgements. With Alwin by DataSnipper, our new agentic platform, AI agents now take on end-to-end audit and finance procedures, while every conclusion stays traceable to its source. That frees professionals to focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

We're trusted by Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. Today, more than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on our platform, and in 2025 alone DataSnipper delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to its customers.

Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, we've built a strong foundation for what's next. And as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

For our Customer Success teams, this is where things get exciting.

Alwin has just launched, demand is growing, and we're expanding into new markets and segments. With a product customers already rely on, there's a huge opportunity to make your mark.

About Us

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

Our Systems Integration Team is seeking a Model-Based Systems Engineer to build the tools and framework we use to design the systems that operate our VIO and QPU technology. This role is focused on establishing QuantWare’s MBSE methodology and turning knowledge from cryogenics, wiring, control electronics and software into a single, executable system model. You will define how we model our systems and build the libraries, analyses and integrations that make the model useful day to day. Working closely with processor, hardware and software teams, you will play an important role in enabling the design of the large-scale quantum computers built around VIO-powered QPUs.

What are you going to do?

  • Define and own QuantWare’s MBSE methodology, modelling conventions and architecture framework for quantum computing systems, covering the quantum processor, cryostat, signal chain, control and readout electronics, and software stack.

  • Select, set up and maintain the MBSE toolchain (e.g. SysML v2, Capella or Cameo), including version control, model reviews and integration with existing engineering tools.

  • Build reusable model libraries for key subsystems, including QPU interfaces, cryogenic wiring and attenuation, microwave signal paths, and control electronics.

  • Develop automated analyses on top of the model, such as heat-load, signal-integrity and noise budgets, channel counts, scalability, and full-system metrics such as power consumption as qubit counts grow.

  • Establish requirements traceability from customer and system-level requirements down to component specifications and verification tests.

  • Connect the system model to simulation and measurement data, creating a digital thread between design and test.

  • Support system architecture and trade studies for new VIO and QPU generations and customer system integrations.

  • Drive adoption across the company, training and supporting engineers in using the models and tools in their day-to-day work.

Qualifications

Core Requirements:

  • BSc. or MSc. in systems engineering, electrical engineering, physics, mechanical engineering or a related field.

  • 3+ years of hands-on MBSE experience, including building or extending a modelling framework rather than only using existing ones.

  • Hands on experience with hardware system models that encompass multiple subsystems with differing requirements and interfaces.

  • Strong working knowledge of SysML (v1 and/or v2) and at least one MBSE tool, such as Cameo, Capella or equivalent.

  • Proficiency in Python for model automation, analysis and tool integration via APIs.

  • A solid track record in requirements engineering and verification of complex, multidisciplinary hardware systems.

  • Strong organisational and communication skills. You thrive in a cross-disciplinary environment and are comfortable taking ownership from day one.

  • Experience with cryogenic, RF/microwave or precision instrumentation systems, or direct experience with superconducting quantum hardware.

  • Background in high-tech, semiconductor, aerospace or scientific instrumentation industries.

  • Experience introducing MBSE into an organisation and driving its adoption.

  • Familiarity with SysML v2 APIs, digital thread concepts or co-simulation (e.g. FMI), as well as systems engineering standards such as ISO/IEC 15288.

About myTomorrows 

myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options.   

We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem.   

We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection.   

With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business.  

Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. 

The opportunity: Director of Pharma Partnerships, Patient Recruitment

As Director of Pharma Partnerships, you will play a pivotal role in driving revenue growth through partnerships with Biopharmaceutical Companies related to myTomorrows' Patient Recruitment products and services for clinical trials. You will be responsible for generating leads and establishing partnerships and alliances that support our business objectives and enhance our clinical trial portfolio.

You will develop and own strategic collaborations with BioPharma companies, from emerging innovators to global leaders, driving measurable revenue growth through our Patient Recruitment solutions and expanding our market footprint. Success in this role requires a sharp commercial mindset and proven expertise in networking, lead generation, proposal and budget development, strategic partnership development, and closing high value deals.

You will be directly accountable for delivering revenue targets through strategic deals and long-term partnerships, effectively managing opportunities from lead generation through contract award, with a clear focus on pipeline conversion, deal velocity and high win rates.

Additionally, you must continually stay informed about our capabilities, as well as industry trends, market developments, and competitor activities. This, collaborating closely with our operations team, marketing team, revenue operations team and as part of the Clinical Trials Business Unit.

Geographic Requirement: This role is open to candidates in The Netherlands, United Kingdom, Canada and USA. For candidates in North America, to ensure seamless collaboration with our teams, applicants must reside within the EST or CST time zones.

What you'll do in this role:

  • Continuously network and generate a high number of leads, supported by a BDR

  • Develop and execute a partnership strategy focused on acquiring new partners and expanding existing relationships within the pharmaceutical industry

  • Own and exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets by driving pipeline conversion, accelerating deal velocity, and meeting or surpassing partnership targets and sales quotas.

  • Qualify deals, negotiate agreements, and close deals that align with company objectives.

  • Manage the end-to-end proposal process from opportunity qualification through contract award, including scope definition and budget development, ensuring submissions are competitive, accurate, and aligned with client needs.

  • Support the development of sales enablement material, working closely with product marketing.

  • Serve as a primary presenter during capabilities presentations, bid defenses and commercial discussions, effectively articulating myTomorrows' value proposition, Patient Recruitment expertise, and differentiated solutions.

  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to ensure the successful and seamless implementation and delivery of partnership commitments.

  • Identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities and support contracting related to the expansion services for existing clients

  • Monitor market, industry and competitor trends, as well as customer feedback to identify partnership opportunities and product/service enhancements.

  • Track and manage pipeline activities in HubSpot, ensuring accurate reporting and forecasting.

  • Represent the company at industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities to build brand awareness and expand the company's presence within the pharmaceutical sector.

  • Travel to clients, conferences and prospects across the globe (up to 60% of the time)

What you bring to the table:

  • Master’s degree in Business Administration, Life Science, Healthcare (Bachelor’s degree considered with strong experience)

  • 8+ years of experience in partnership development, business development, or sales roles, with a strong focus on contracting and closing deals within the pharmaceutical industry

  • An existing network within the pharmaceutical industry, preferably within clinical development, clinical operations, and pre-approval access space.

  • Consistent and proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets and closing high-value deals.

  • Strong understanding of clinical trials and patient recruitment.

  • Excellent negotiation, communication, and presentation skills in English.

  • Deep understanding of the full sales cycle, from early lead generation to contract negotiation and post-deal expansion.

  • The ability to identify market opportunities and develop actionable plans.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and lead cross-functional initiatives.

Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. 

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

CBRE Global Workplace Solutions (GWS) is wereldwijd marktleider in geïntegreerd facilitair management, technisch beheer, projectmanagement en vastgoedservices. Wij ondersteunen enkele van de meest toonaangevende organisaties ter wereld bij het creëren, onderhouden en optimaliseren van hun werkomgevingen.

Als onderdeel van CBRE, met meer dan 155.000 medewerkers wereldwijd, combineren wij lokale expertise met de kracht van een toonaangevend internationaal netwerk. Onze teams leveren innovatieve oplossingen op het gebied van technisch onderhoud, facility management, energiebeheer, projecten en werkplekoptimalisatie.

Bij CBRE geloven we dat onze mensen het verschil maken. Daarom investeren we in ontwikkeling, samenwerking en een veilige, inclusieve werkomgeving waarin iedereen kan groeien. Ben jij een ervaren Project Manager met een technische achtergrond en een passie voor het succesvol realiseren van complexe projecten?

We are looking for an experienced Senior Integration Software Engineer to bring our algorithms and software backend together into reliable, operational solutions, and to take technical ownership of how our software is integrated.

Optics11 is a deep-tech company developing advanced fiber-optic sensing technologies for challenging environments and applications in energy and underwater security. Our systems enable high-performance sensing and monitoring through advanced photonics, signal processing, and data-driven intelligence.

We are expanding our R&D team with an Integration Software Engineer who enjoys building clean, reliable interfaces between components and working where software meets hardware, and who takes ownership of making complex systems work together end to end.

As a Senior Integration Software Engineer, you will support their integration into operational systems: connecting algorithms to the backend through robust APIs, building data connectors, health reporting and control software, and defining and verifying integrations with Command and Control (C2) systems.

You will work closely with domain experts in acoustics, signal processing and machine learning, and with the software engineering team, and hands-on with our monitoring systems at our headquarters and production facility. You will also take technical ownership of work delivered by internal and external engineers and set the standard for good engineering practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead software integration engineering for our underwater acoustic sensing systems, ensuring frontend and backend components, algorithms, and hardware systems work together reliably.

  • Integrate the algorithmic toolbox with our system backends, turning research code into maintainable, versioned and deployable software components.

  • Implement data interfaces for our real-time sonar processing pipeline, to ingest multiple sensors (acoustic, heading, temperature, pressure, etc.) from internal and external data acquisition systems. Implement health reporting, logging and monitoring, so that the status and performance of software and system components is visible and actionable.

  • Develop the software control layer for our sensing systems and their hardware components, including APIs for commanding, state handling, error handling and recovery.

  • Implement, align and verify software integrations with external partners and C2 systems, being directly involved in defining interfaces, maintaining interface specifications and running joint integration tests.

  • Testing & debugging: Develop system-level test suites and CI/CD pipelines, diagnose communication failures, and ensure secure, reliable data transfers as the toolbox and backends evolve.

  • Address performance, latency and scalability of the integrated pipeline, together with algorithm and backend developers.

  • Work hands-on with integrated software and hardware systems at our headquarters and production facility, with occasional on-site visits.

  • Review the work of junior engineers and external development partners in depth, promote good practices for packaging, versioning and release, and share integration knowledge across the team.

Why Join Us?

  • Join one of Europe’s most promising deep-tech scale-ups.

  • Shape the future of a rapidly growing multidisciplinary R&D organization.

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.

  • Enjoy regular team activities and company events.

  • Fresh team lunches provided 5 times/week.


Qualifications:

  • BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field.

  • Significant professional experience in software engineering, with a focus on system integration, backend or platform development.

  • Extensive experience developing production software in Python, including packaging, testing, dependency management and writing maintainable, well-structured code.

  • Familiarity with systems programming in C++, or Rust, for the purpose of extending Python for more performance or hardware control.

  • Proven experience designing and implementing APIs and messaging interfaces (e.g. MQTT, WebSocket) and data serialization (e.g. protobuf).

  • Experience with realtime data pipelines, and handling high-throughput or streaming data.

  • Experience with Docker, CI/CD and automated testing in a Linux environment.

  • Experience working with software that interacts with physical systems, and comfort doing hands-on integration and troubleshooting in a lab or production environment.

  • Experience reviewing code and designs, mentoring junior engineers, and setting engineering standards.

  • An outcome-focused mindset, with the ability to own a problem end to end or break it down for others.

  • Ability to work with algorithm developers and translate research code into robust, maintainable software.

  • Flexible and proactive in taking on what needs to be addressed, and comfortable in a fast-paced scale-up environment.

  • Good communication skills in English and the ability to coordinate with internal teams and external partners.

  • Willingness to work primarily from our Amsterdam headquarters, as parts of the role involve classified information and physical systems.

Nice to Have:

  • Knowledge of defense systems or defense standards (e.g. NATO STANAGs, MIL-STD), for example in naval, maritime security or surveillance systems.

  • Experience with the scientific Python stack (e.g. NumPy, SciPy) or integrating signal processing or ML models into production systems.

  • Experience developing software interfaces for controlling instruments or devices.

  • Experience with other messaging or streaming frameworks (e.g. Kafka, ZeroMQ, DDS).

  • Familiarity with observability tooling.

Security & Compliance:

You'll be working with clients in the defense and security sectors, obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD (Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service) is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. For more information, please refer to details on security screening.

Krijg jij energie van een financiële administratie die tot in de puntjes klopt? Heb je ruime ervaring met boekhouding en houd je graag overzicht over financiële processen? Bij Normec Foodcare zoeken we een ervaren Senior Medewerker Finance & Accounting die zelfstandig de financiële administratie beheert, afwijkingen signaleert en bijdraagt aan een correcte maand- en jaarafsluiting.

Jouw rol

Als Boekhoudkundig Medewerker ben je verantwoordelijk voor een correcte en tijdige verwerking van de financiële administratie. Je houdt je bezig met debiteuren, crediteuren, cashmanagement en grootboekcontroles. Daarnaast bereid je de maand- en jaarafsluiting voor en werk je nauw samen met de Financial Controller en andere collega's binnen Finance. Je maakt deel uit van een Finance-team van zeven collega's en rapporteert rechtstreeks aan Patricia Pouw, Finance Manager.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden zijn verder:

  • Debiteuren- en crediteurenbeheer: Je beheert de openstaande posten, verwerkt ontvangsten en inkoopfacturen en onderhoudt contact met klanten en leveranciers over betalingen en factuurverschillen.

  • Cashmanagement: Je verwerkt bankmutaties, bewaakt de geldstromen en bereidt betalingen voor. Ook ondersteun je bij de liquiditeitsplanning.

  • Voorbereiden van de maand- en jaarafsluiting: Je zorgt dat de administratie volledig en tijdig is bijgewerkt. Je bereidt boekingen, reserveringen en balansspecificaties voor en ondersteunt bij de jaarafsluiting en accountantscontrole.

  • Grootboek en financiële controles: Je controleert grootboekrekeningen en financiële aansluitingen, onderzoekt afwijkingen en bereidt correcties voor.

  • Aanvullende administratie: Je houdt je bezig met intercompany-afstemmingen, vaste activa en de voorbereiding van btw-aangiften.

  • Procesverbetering: Je signaleert knelpunten, doet verbetervoorstellen en helpt de kwaliteit en efficiëntie van de financiële administratie verder te verbeteren.

Daarnaast ben je een inhoudelijk aanspreekpunt voor collega's bij complexere boekhoudkundige vraagstukken en ondersteun je hen met jouw kennis en ervaring.

Ons aanbod

Een afwisselende functie bij Normec Foodcare, met ruimte om zelfstandig te werken, mee te denken en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Je komt terecht in een betrokken team waarin samenwerking centraal staat. Wat je verder mag verwachten:

  • Een jaarcontract met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband

  • Een salaris tussen € 4.000 en € 4.500 bruto per maand op basis van een fulltime dienstverband, afhankelijk van jouw ervaring

  • Een dienstverband van bij voorkeur 40 uur per week. Een dienstverband van 32 uur per week is ook bespreekbaar

  • Hybride werken en flexibele werktijden: je kunt je werkdag indelen tussen 07.00 en 19.00 uur

  • 25 vakantiedagen en 8% vakantietoeslag

  • De mogelijkheid om extra vakantiedagen te kopen

  • Een goede pensioenregeling

  • Een reiskostenvergoeding

  • De mogelijkheid om deel te nemen aan het fietsplan

  • Een continu ontwikkelprogramma waarin je wordt gestimuleerd om je talenten verder te ontwikkelen

  • Een collectieve ziektekostenverzekering bij VGZ

  • Een actieve personeelsvereniging die het hele jaar door diverse leuke activiteiten organiseert

Jouw profiel

Je bent een positief kritisch ingestelde en betrokken professional, die graag meedenkt en bouwt aan onze Finance-afdeling.

Daarnaast beschik je over:

  • Mbo+/hbo werk- en denkniveau in een financiële of boekhoudkundige richting

  • Minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring als Boekhouder, Financieel Administratief Medewerker of in een vergelijkbare financiële functie

  • Ruime ervaring met zelfstandig boekhouden, debiteuren- en crediteurenbeheer en het voorbereiden van maandafsluitingen

  • Een goed begrip van grootboekadministratie, balansposten, btw en de samenhang tussen boekingen en financiële rapportages

  • Goede vaardigheden in Excel en ervaring met een ERP-systeem. Kennis van Exact Online of Business Central is een pré

  • Je hebt een goede beheersing van de Engelse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk

  • Een nauwkeurige, gestructureerde en proactieve werkwijze. Je voert niet alleen werkzaamheden uit, maar onderzoekt ook zelfstandig afwijkingen en denkt mee over oplossingen

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om prettig samen te werken met klanten, leveranciers en collega's. Je deelt graag je kennis en ondersteunt anderen waar nodig

  • Je bent bij voorkeur 40 uur per week beschikbaar

Over Normec

Normec Foodlab Ede is onderdeel van Normec, toonaangevend in de Testen, Inspectie, Certificering en Compliance (TICC) industrie. Onze expertise raakt essentiële gebieden zoals water-, lucht- en bodemkwaliteit, brandveiligheid en voedselveiligheid, waarbij we de hoogste normen van kwaliteit en veiligheid garanderen in verschillende sectoren. Normec is opgericht in 2016 en is een ambitieuze, onafhankelijke en snelgroeiende organisatie.

We bieden onze collega’s de kans om actief bij te dragen aan onze missie én tegelijkertijd hun eigen carrière te ontwikkelen binnen een dynamische en snelgroeiende organisatie. Samen werken we aan impactvolle oplossingen voor onze klanten en aan een duurzame toekomst. De cultuur binnen Normec is informeel, open, energiek en ondernemend en is verankerd in onze GROWTH-principes. Middels ons The Normec Fit-programma, waarmee de deze principes tot leven brengen, zorgen we ervoor dat niet alleen ons bedrijf groeit, maar ook iedereen die er deel van uitmaakt.

Interesse? Laten we kennismaken!

Ben je geïnteresseerd in deze vacature? Dan kijken we uit naar jouw sollicitatie! We behandelen jouw gegevens vertrouwelijk en zorgen ervoor dat je binnen vijf werkdagen een reactie van ons ontvangt.  Voor vragen over deze vacature kun je contact opnemen met team Recruitment, via . Zij helpen je graag verder.

De procedure:

  • Eerste telefonische screening en verdere bespreking van de vacature

  • Persoonlijk gesprek bij Normec

  • Referentiecheck (na jouw goedkeuring)/ assessment

  • Tweede gesprek/bespreken arbeidsvoorwaarden bij Normec

  • Gefeliciteerd, je hebt je nieuwe uitdaging gevonden

 Op zoek naar een nieuwe uitdaging binnen de voedingsmiddelenindustrie, maar is deze functie niet helemaal wat je zoekt? Volg Careers at Normec Foodcare op LinkedIn en blijf op de hoogte van al onze vacatures.

Ongevraagde acquisitie door bureaus wordt niet op prijs gesteld en zal niet worden beantwoord.

Over Nedlin

Nedlin is een industriële textielverzorger voor Healthcare, Hospitality en Industry, waar veiligheid, kwaliteit, continu verbeteren en verantwoord ondernemen centraal staan. Als groeiend B-Corp familiebedrijf investeren we graag in jong talent en versterken we de verbinding tussen onderwijs en arbeidsmarkt. Daarom bieden we studenten de kans om praktijkervaring op te doen, zich te ontwikkelen en Nedlin te leren kennen, met waar mogelijk mooie doorgroeikansen na het afstuderen.

De stageopdrachten

Tijdens deze stage binnen Nedlin Industry ga je aan de slag met een actueel vraagstuk uit onze dagelijkse operatie. Je onderzoekt waar verbeterkansen liggen, brengt processen en knelpunten in kaart en werkt jouw bevindingen uit tot concrete verbetervoorstellen.

Afhankelijk van jouw interesse kun je kiezen uit één van de volgende stageopdrachten:

  1. Klantcompleetheid verbeteren
    Onderzoek waar en waarom klantorders niet volledig worden geleverd, breng knelpunten binnen productie en expeditie in kaart en werk concrete verbeteringen.

  2. Transportkosten reduceren
    Analyseer transportkosten en routes, onderzoek de beladingsgraad en leverfrequenties en breng mogelijke kostenbesparingen in kaart.

  3. Doorlooptijden magazijn verbeteren
    Breng de magazijnprocessen in kaart, identificeer wachttijden en onnodige handelingen en werk verbeteringen uit om de doorlooptijd te verkorten.

  4. Gebruik van AI binnen de organisatie
    Onderzoek de mogelijkheden voor AI binnen de organisatie, bepaal kansrijke toepassingen voor de dagelijkse operatie en werk deze concreet uit.

  5. Werkinstructies vouwers en inpak verbeteren
    Beoordeel de huidige werkinstructies en onderzoek hoe deze eenvoudiger, duidelijker en visueler kunnen worden gemaakt voor medewerkers.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Stagevergoeding:

    • € 300,- bruto per maand voor mbo-studenten (op basis van 40 uur per week);

    • € 400,- bruto per maand voor hbo-studenten (op basis van 40 uur per week);

  • Een leerzame stage binnen één van de modernste en duurzaamste wasserijen van Europa;

  • Ruimte en begeleiding om te werken aan jouw (afstudeer)opdracht;

  • Persoonlijke begeleiding en korte lijnen;

  • Een familiaire en positieve sfeer: samen feestdagen vieren, een jaarlijkse familiedag en leuke uitjes;

  • Kans op een (bij)baan bij Nedlin na afronding van je stage, bij wederzijdse match.


Wie ben jij?

  • Je volgt een hbo-opleiding of een mbo-4-opleiding en kunt aantoonbaar zelfstandig werken.

  • Je studeert bijvoorbeeld Technische Bedrijfskunde, Operations Management, Kwaliteitsmanagement, Human Factors, Communicatie of een vergelijkbare richting.

  • Je bent analytisch en oplettend, schrijft helder en kunt informatie eenvoudig en visueel overbrengen.

  • Je werkt zorgvuldig en zelfstandig en legt gemakkelijk contact met collega’s op de werkvloer.

  • Je zoekt een onderzoeks- en implementatiestage, waarbij gedeeltelijk meewerken in de praktijk mogelijk is..

Pak het moment

Wil jij tijdens je stage niet alleen werken aan een interessante opdracht, maar vooral ook leren, ervaring opdoen en jezelf ontwikkelen? Bij Nedlin krijg je de ruimte om jouw kennis vanuit je opleiding toe te passen in de praktijk, mee te kijken binnen onze organisatie en samen te werken met ervaren collega’s. Europa verandert. Steeds meer mensen kiezen voor vrijheid — als zzp'er, freelancer of ondernemer. Ze bepalen zelf wanneer, hoe en met wie ze werken. Maar die vrijheid komt met een keerzijde: onzekerheid.

Geen ingewikkeld papierwerk, geen gedoe. Vandaag geregeld, morgen verzekerd.

Most insurance product roles ask you to perfect one product in one market. This one asks you to build Europe’s SME insurance products: decide what we cover and who we insure, negotiate it with our carriers and get it live, market after market.

Deep in the wording. Fast in the build.

About Insify

Insurance for entrepreneurs is still built the old way: one market at a time, wordings nobody reads, and cover that leaves out the very businesses that need it most.

We're doing it differently.

Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by €43M in total funding from world-class investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years, we've expanded from the Netherlands into France, Germany and Ireland, and we're just getting started. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance.

We aren't just building a company; we're leading a revolution. Our culture is intense, high-stakes, and mission-driven. We hire smart, ambitious "owners" who possess a relentless drive to win. This is an environment for those who thrive on challenges, value intellectual honesty, and share our mindset of becoming a global category leader.

Our founding team consists of seasoned entrepreneurs who have previously built iconic businesses like HelloFresh, Bloomon, and SumUp. We bring that same bias for speed, scale, and high standards to one of the most structurally broken experiences in financial services. Together, we combine that deep fintech and e-commerce expertise with cutting-edge AI to stay ahead of the curve.


What you’ll own in your first year

You won’t inherit a finished product shelf. You’ll build the engine that fills it.

  1. Build the product engine. Turn how we benchmark a market into a system: compare cover, limits and exclusions across local players, our Dutch home product and our other markets, so every new product starts from facts, not gut feeling.
  2. Make the call on cover. Decide what we cover, what we don’t and who we insure, and turn it into a proposal. The tools do the comparison; the judgment is yours.
  3. Get it signed. Take the proposal to our risk carriers and negotiate it. You know what to push on, what to let go and which clause will set off six red flags.
  4. Get it live. Adapt our wordings to each new market, run the legal review and launch. Less writing from scratch, more making one strong product fit the next market. Then track loss ratios, competition and customer feedback, and sharpen it.
  5. Build what doesn’t exist yet. In the markets where we double down, own custom products from the insurance side, including cover for the trades and businesses others decline.

Who you are

You’re an insurance expert first and a builder second, but a real one.

  • You have 5+ years hands-on in commercial P&C (Property & Casualty) at an insurer, MGA, (re)insurer or specialist broker, across underwriting, product and wordings, ideally for SMEs.
  • You know what is covered, what isn’t and what should be. Hand you a wording from a market you’ve never worked in and you’ll spot the gaps within minutes.
  • You’ve worked across more than one line, product or market, and you can apply what you know to a market you’ve never seen.
  • You’ve sat at the table with insurers or capacity providers and know where the red lines are.
  • You’d rather fix insurance than complain about it. Maybe you already tried: at an insurtech, an MGA, your own startup, or on the carrier side building products with insurtechs.
  • You think like the customer: plain questions, fair cover, and no excluding everything just to be safe.
  • You’re at home in Excel and data, and curious about what automation and LLMs can take off your plate. You don’t need to code; our product and tech teams build the digital journey with you.
  • You work fluently in English; German, French or Dutch is a big plus.

    • What we offer
  • Real ownership. You decide what we cover and work directly with the MT, close to where decisions get made.
  • Range. More products and markets in a year than most people see in a decade at an incumbent.
  • A share in what we build. Equity, so you share in the value you build.
  • A team that cares. We live by four values: Grit, Care, Impact and Entrepreneurship.
  • Growth. Room to grow into leading our insurance product work as we add markets, plus an in-house coaching and leadership program.
  • The package. Competitive salary package + 6% pension, holidays, well-being budget and rich social events (ski trip, summer and winter party).
  • The basics, done well. Office in central Amsterdam, laptop, hybrid working. Relocation support.

    • If you know insurance inside out and you’d rather build products than maintain them, we’d like to meet you. No cover letter needed.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a member of our Security Operations Team, you will collaborate with a global team of engineers to monitor and respond to security events, lead security incidents as Incident Commander, and lead digital forensic investigations in support of Employee Relations, Legal, Compliance, or Information Security cases.

Although you will be focused on security incident response, you will also have the opportunity to create and maintain runbooks, and automated workflows, and assist in process refinement and implementation. You will collaborate with a diverse team of engineers, and key stakeholders on security initiatives across the company. Above all, your focus is bringing Security expertise to the table in a collaborative, humble, and practical manner.

Location: This role is open to candidates residing in the UK

You should apply if:

  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will: 

  • Monitor security events and provide technical analysis on alerts
  • Lead information security incidents and employee insider investigations by developing the incident response strategy, lead the execution through incident closure, while providing incident updates to key stakeholders throughout the incident
  • Deliver security guidance clearly and concisely for incident response and insider threat initiatives
  • Coordinate the building of services, capabilities, integrations, and implementations of technologies to support security operations, incident response, and insider threat
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Participate in our on-call rota covering weekends

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years of experience in Security Incident Response
  • Ability to communicate investigative findings and strategies to technical staff, executive leadership, and legal
  • Ability to build scripts or tools to support Samsara's investigation processes, with proficiency in Python
  • Mentor and train security operation engineers on data collection, analysis, and reporting technical analysis
  • Practical experience acting as a lead during security incident response, including monitoring and triaging alerts, and coordinating across teams
  • Understanding of analysis and forensics techniques on macOS, Windows, and Linux
  • Experience utilizing SIEM tools to perform log reviews
  • Experience in cloud architecture and security (AWS, GCP) and cloud-based services
  • Participation in an on-call rotation, with the potential to work outside standard business hours, including late evenings, when responding to high-severity incidents as part of our global incident response team.
  • This role will be part of our EMEA so your hours will be aligned to the UK. As an operational time you may be expected to work flexible hours around this to support the load of the team

An ideal candidate also has:

  • 2+ years of experience working on insider threat initiatives or employee investigations
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field - or relevant industry experience
  • GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH) or similar Certification
  • Familiarity with common security frameworks and standards, including NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO 27001, FedRAMP

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

data.description:
Lightspeed is driven by building the restaurant platform that helps restaurants adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: building the businesses they love.

As a Field Account Executive, you will be part of a team that is transforming the way restaurants operate. Using a consultative approach, you will prospect, build relationships, and sign up new restaurateurs in your local area. By understanding their unique needs, you will develop a customised solution that helps their business thrive. We need your passion and sales expertise to help us build the Lightspeed brand in your area. 

Your responsibilities:

  • Generate lists of prospective restaurants and manage the entire sales cycle from initial outbound call/ walk in to close (experience with self-sourcing clients is a huge plus)

  • Conduct demos and develop a solution that best meets the prospect’s needs 

  • Partner with teams across the business to ensure that expectations set during the sales process are met in delivery

  • Leverage Salesforce (our CRM) to manage all sales activities

  • Understand the competitive landscape and determine how to best position Lightspeed in the market

What you will bring to the team: 

  • Dutch fluency is a must 

  • Experience in a sourcing or closing customers, restaurant operations, or a relatable field and industry

  • Since this is a field position, you will be out and about on a daily basis in your territory 

  • Strong communication, organisational and presentation skills with the ability to sell and negotiate at all decision-making levels

  • Proven track record of success in meeting and exceeding goals

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial and team environment

  • Self-motivated, creative, and flexible

  • General technical proficiency with software

  • Experience with Salesforce CRM is a plus

What’s in it for you?

Come Live the Lightspeed Experience….

  • Genuine career growth opportunities based on performance within a company that's continuously expanding.

  • Uncapped commission

  • Work with highly skilled people who are as passionate about sales & marketing as you are

  • An environment that encourages initiatives and leadership

  • Work in a team big enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact;

and enjoy a range of benefits that’ll keep you happy, healthy and (not) hungry:

  • Lightspeed equity scheme (we are all owners)

  • Health & Wellness Credit- expense up to 400 EUR per year towards your gym membership, yoga classes, a new bike or whatever else you do for your health 

  • Mental Health Support through the Modern Health App- whether it is meditation, coaching or counseling you need - each employee gets access to this platform 

  • People Experience - Our PX benefit allows you to work from pretty much anywhere in the world for 60 days a year 

  • LinkedIn Learning: At Lightspeed we believe in having a growth mindset, we provide free access to LinkedIn learning along with your career GPS to help you learn & grow

  • Subsidy to annual travel pass if you travel by public transport to the office 

  • Regular breakfast or lunches, drinks & snacks in our Amsterdam office 

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who we are:

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

Lightspeed handles your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Statement.
